entities.name: FMO5-like query protein
observations: 538-aa query has 47.2% identity and 98.1% query coverage to reviewed human FMO5 (UniProt P49326); functional transfer is homology-supported, not a direct query-specific experiment.
FMO5 reference is an FAD-dependent monooxygenase reported to catalyze NADPH/O2-dependent Baeyer–Villiger oxygen insertion adjacent to ketone carbonyls, yielding esters.

entities.name: Baeyer–Villiger oxidation
observations: General reaction: ketone + NADPH + O2 + H+ → ester + NADP+ + H2O; an oxygen atom is inserted into a C–C bond adjacent to the carbonyl. Specific substrates vary; retrieved examples include heptan-2-one and octan-3-one.
